items.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023
items.q: We did that live on the Ed Sullivan Show and they set us up in a straight line about nine to ten feet above Nat Pierce piano, Ronnie Zito drums, and Charlie “The Arm” bass

ctx.x: Yeah. We did that live on the Ed Sullivan Show and they set us up in a straight line about nine to ten feet above Nat Pierce piano, Ronnie Zito drums, and Charlie “The Arm” bass, who always played acoustic without an amp. Yeah. You know it. And it worked you know.
I was anticipating a train wreck actually.
